title: A stacked PR uses a parent parser that returns null, with no null check

pr.title: Read the daily quota from API_QUOTA
pr.description: Reads the daily request quota of each API key from API_QUOTA. It uses parseQuota from the parent pull request.

parent.title: Add parseQuota for quota settings
parent.description: Adds parseQuota. It parses values such as "500" or "2k" and returns null for a missing or malformed value, so the caller picks the fallback.

bugs.note: parseQuota of the parent returns null for a missing or malformed API_QUOTA, as its comment says. The non-null assertion hides that. dailyQuota then returns null, and used < null is false, so every request is refused when API_QUOTA is not set. Fall back to DEFAULT_QUOTA.

traps.why: The parent pull request adds parseQuota, and null is its documented result for a bad value. This change does not touch it. A finding on the return null lines blames parent code; the defect is the caller in src/api/limits.ts.
